sources.title: Independent Natural Earth land and water reference
sources.publisher: Natural Earth / NACIS; Tom Patterson and Nathaniel Vaughn Kelso

access_metadata.historical_applicability: Modern generalized physical reference only; not circa1900 shoreline, engineering, water level or political evidence
access_metadata.usage_status: Public domain Natural Earth; full GIS excluded from release
access_metadata.scope: Modern physical reference. Original NE land holes/components and existing Syvash natural-water correction. Inland lake overlays retain their own sources; not a complete global lake survey.
access_metadata.data_transformation: R27 independent globally simplified land; full tile land and its water complement; constrained triangulation; same source boundary for coast. No political input, difference halo, inferred owner or nearest-country association.
access_metadata.uncertainty: Modern shoreline alterations, glacial change, reservoirs and channel migration are not reconstructed

access_metadata.source_scale: Mixed OSM source scale; accuracy unquantified
access_metadata.historical_applicability: Modern high-water reference, not 1900 port/coast reconstruction
access_metadata.data_transformation: Directed-source polygonisation; 8m display simplification; only closed shoreline differences at real NE/OSM intersections. Acquisition-edge differences excluded.

access_metadata.source_scale: Mixed OSM source scale; accuracy unquantified
access_metadata.historical_applicability: Modern high-water reference, not 1900 port/coast reconstruction
access_metadata.data_transformation: IGN high-water lines polygonised; old admitted land labels dominant closed faces; 8m display simplification. Only closed shoreline differences replaced. Ambiguous labels and acquisition-edge differences are not invented.
